newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market firm-up $0.50 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market firm-up $0.50 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were firm to $0.50 per cwt higher, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade moderate. Demand moderate to good. Seller interest moderate. Offerings light and current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1175-1300 lbs 71.00-72.00 Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 71.00-72.00 few higher dressing Choice 73.00.
